_readme: S639 harvest side session (second session), 2026-11-12. The hours each noncredit course description prints in Victor Valley College's 2026-2027 CourseLeaf catalog (catalog.vvc.edu/course-descriptions/<prefix>/), read by college-page-read 43134526902 (plan kb/college_reads/victor_valley_noncredit_hours.json, thirteen prefixes). A course printed at 0.0 Units carries its 'Lecture Hours' plus its 'Lab Hours', one figure each (WKPR 011: 'Lecture Hours: 36.0'; COSM 0101: 'Lecture Hours: 171.0; Lab Hours: 108.0', 279). A credit course is left out: its hours never price a noncredit record, and ESL 12A (3.0 Units, 54 hours) shares ESL 012A's normalized code (ESL12A, 108 hours). Keyed in norm_code form; 'words' quotes each description's heading and hours line. Parsed from the job log: each heading 'CODE  Title  (0.0 Units)' to the next, its 'Lecture Hours: n' and 'Lab Hours: n' added. The course_hours step of Victor Valley's reconcile entry reads this file (hours_file), only in a record measured in hours and never over a figure the reading gave.
